# Plan: Decouple Runner from Direct UI Dependencies

## Context

The runner module (`src/runner/workflow.rs`) uses the `UserInterface` trait for prompts and spinners, but still has tight coupling through:

1. **`SpinnerHandle::progress_bar()`** returns `Option<indicatif::ProgressBar>`, leaking the `indicatif` crate through the trait boundary (`ui/mod.rs:48,195`)
2. **`live_output_callback`** imported directly from `ui::spinner` into the runner (`workflow.rs:19`)
3. **`BivvyTheme`** instantiated directly in the runner for formatting step headers and status messages (`workflow.rs:20,317`)
4. **Raw `println!`** for verbose non-interactive output, bypassing the UI abstraction (`workflow.rs:620-628`)
5. **`OutputMode` inspection** for UI rendering decisions (`workflow.rs:601-608,700-701`)

## Commit 1: Output callback decoupling

Replace `progress_bar()` with `create_output_callback()` on `SpinnerHandle`. Add `create_verbose_output_callback()` and `was_output_streamed()` to `UserInterface`. Remove all output callback construction from the runner.

### `src/ui/mod.rs`
- Remove `use indicatif::ProgressBar;` (line 48)
- Replace `progress_bar()` on `SpinnerHandle` with:
  ```rust
  fn create_output_callback(&self, base_message: &str, indent: usize) -> Option<OutputCallback> { None }
  ```
- Add to `UserInterface`:
  ```rust
  fn create_verbose_output_callback(&self) -> Option<OutputCallback> { None }
  fn was_output_streamed(&self) -> bool { false }
  ```

### `src/ui/spinner.rs`
- Add `output_mode: OutputMode` field to `ProgressSpinner`
- Update `new()`, `with_indent()` to accept `OutputMode`; `hidden()` uses `OutputMode::Silent`
- Implement `create_output_callback()`: compute max_lines from output_mode (3 for Verbose, 2 for Normal, None for others), call `live_output_callback` internally
- Make `live_output_callback` private (`pub fn` -> `fn`)
- Remove `progress_bar()` impl
- Update tests: remove `progress_bar_returns_clone`, add `create_output_callback` tests

### `src/ui/terminal.rs`
- Pass `self.mode` to `ProgressSpinner::new()` / `with_indent()` / `hidden()`

### `src/ui/non_interactive.rs`
- Implement `create_verbose_output_callback()`: return `Some(callback)` when verbose
- Implement `was_output_streamed()`: return `self.mode == OutputMode::Verbose`

### `src/runner/workflow.rs`
- Remove `use crate::ui::spinner::live_output_callback;` (line 19)
- Remove `use crate::shell::OutputLine;` if no longer needed
- Replace lines 601-633 (output callback creation) with:
  ```rust
  let output_callback = spinner
      .create_output_callback(&attempt_label, 6)
      .or_else(|| ui.create_verbose_output_callback());
  ```
- Replace line 700-701 (`output_was_streamed` check) with `if !ui.was_output_streamed()`
- Remove `let output_mode = ui.output_mode();` (line 601)

## Commit 2: Formatting decoupling

Add `show_step_header()` and `show_status_message()` to `UserInterface`. Remove `BivvyTheme` from the runner.

### `src/ui/mod.rs`
Add to `UserInterface`:
```rust
fn show_step_header(&mut self, index: usize, total: usize, name: &str, title: &str) { ... }
fn show_status_message(&mut self, status: StatusKind, message: &str, indent: usize) { ... }
```
Default implementations use plain text.

### `src/ui/terminal.rs`
Implement both methods using `self.theme` for styled output.

### `src/ui/non_interactive.rs`
Implement both methods using plain text with `StatusKind::icon()`.

### `src/ui/mock.rs`
- Add `step_headers: Vec<(usize, usize, String, String)>` and `status_messages: Vec<(StatusKind, String)>` fields
- Implement both methods to capture data and delegate to `self.messages`
- Add accessor methods

### `src/runner/workflow.rs`
- Remove `use crate::ui::theme::BivvyTheme;` (line 20)
- Remove `let theme = BivvyTheme::new();` (line 317)
- Compute a plain-text `step_display` for prompt questions: `format!("[{}/{}] {}", index + 1, total, step_name)`
- Replace `ui.message(&step_display)` calls at lines 378, 401, 464, 470, 517 with `ui.show_step_header(index + 1, total, step_name, &step.title)`
- Replace `theme.format_skipped(...)` calls with `ui.show_status_message(StatusKind::Skipped, ..., 4)`
- Replace `StatusKind::Blocked.format(&theme, ...)` with `ui.show_status_message(StatusKind::Blocked, ..., 4)`

## Verification

After each commit, all APE gates must pass:
- `cargo test --all-features` — 0 failures
- `cargo doc --no-deps --all-features` — 0 errors
- `cargo fmt -- --check` — 0 diffs
- `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` — 0 errors
- `cargo llvm-cov --all-features` — >= 90% coverage
- `cargo check --all-targets --all-features` — 0 errors
- `cargo build --release` — 0 errors

After both commits, verify:
- `runner/workflow.rs` has no imports from `ui::theme`, `ui::spinner`, or `indicatif`
- `ui/mod.rs` has no `use indicatif` import
- `live_output_callback` is no longer `pub`

The runner module (`src/runner/workflow.rs`) uses the `UserInterface` trait for prompts and spinners, but still has tight coupling through:

1. **`SpinnerHandle::progress_bar()`** returns `Option<indicatif::ProgressBar>`, leaking the `indicatif` crate through the trait boundary (`ui/mod.rs:48,195`)
2. **`live_output_callback`** imported directly from `ui::spinner` into the runner (`workflow.rs:19`)
3. **`BivvyTheme`** instantiated directly in the runner for formatting step headers and status messages (`workflow.rs:20,317`)
4. **Raw `println!`** for verbose non-interactive output, bypassing the UI abstraction (`workflow.rs:620-628`)
5. **`OutputMode` inspection** for UI rendering decisions (`workflow.rs:601-608,700-701`)

## Commit 1: Output callback decoupling

Replace `progress_bar()` with `create_output_callback()` on `SpinnerHandle`. Add `create_verbose_output_callback()` and `was_output_streamed()` to `UserInterface`. Remove all output callback construction from the runner.

### `src/ui/mod.rs`
- Remove `use indicatif::ProgressBar;` (line 48)
- Replace `progress_bar()` on `SpinnerHandle` with:
  ```rust
  fn create_output_callback(&self, base_message: &str, indent: usize) -> Option<OutputCallback> { None }
  ```
- Add to `UserInterface`:
  ```rust
  fn create_verbose_output_callback(&self) -> Option<OutputCallback> { None }
  fn was_output_streamed(&self) -> bool { false }
  ```

### `src/ui/spinner.rs`
- Add `output_mode: OutputMode` field to `ProgressSpinner`
- Update `new()`, `with_indent()` to accept `OutputMode`; `hidden()` uses `OutputMode::Silent`
- Implement `create_output_callback()`: compute max_lines from output_mode (3 for Verbose, 2 for Normal, None for others), call `live_output_callback` internally
- Make `live_output_callback` private (`pub fn` -> `fn`)
- Remove `progress_bar()` impl
- Update tests: remove `progress_bar_returns_clone`, add `create_output_callback` tests

### `src/ui/terminal.rs`
- Pass `self.mode` to `ProgressSpinner::new()` / `with_indent()` / `hidden()`

### `src/ui/non_interactive.rs`
- Implement `create_verbose_output_callback()`: return `Some(callback)` when verbose
- Implement `was_output_streamed()`: return `self.mode == OutputMode::Verbose`

### `src/runner/workflow.rs`
- Remove `use crate::ui::spinner::live_output_callback;` (line 19)
- Remove `use crate::shell::OutputLine;` if no longer needed
- Replace lines 601-633 (output callback creation) with:
  ```rust
  let output_callback = spinner
      .create_output_callback(&attempt_label, 6)
      .or_else(|| ui.create_verbose_output_callback());
  ```
- Replace line 700-701 (`output_was_streamed` check) with `if !ui.was_output_streamed()`
- Remove `let output_mode = ui.output_mode();` (line 601)

## Commit 2: Formatting decoupling

Add `show_step_header()` and `show_status_message()` to `UserInterface`. Remove `BivvyTheme` from the runner.

### `src/ui/mod.rs`
Add to `UserInterface`:
```rust
fn show_step_header(&mut self, index: usize, total: usize, name: &str, title: &str) { ... }
fn show_status_message(&mut self, status: StatusKind, message: &str, indent: usize) { ... }
```
Default implementations use plain text.

### `src/ui/terminal.rs`
Implement both methods using `self.theme` for styled output.

### `src/ui/non_interactive.rs`
Implement both methods using plain text with `StatusKind::icon()`.

### `src/ui/mock.rs`
- Add `step_headers: Vec<(usize, usize, String, String)>` and `status_messages: Vec<(StatusKind, String)>` fields
- Implement both methods to capture data and delegate to `self.messages`
- Add accessor methods

### `src/runner/workflow.rs`
- Remove `use crate::ui::theme::BivvyTheme;` (line 20)
- Remove `let theme = BivvyTheme::new();` (line 317)
- Compute a plain-text `step_display` for prompt questions: `format!("[{}/{}] {}", index + 1, total, step_name)`
- Replace `ui.message(&step_display)` calls at lines 378, 401, 464, 470, 517 with `ui.show_step_header(index + 1, total, step_name, &step.title)`
- Replace `theme.format_skipped(...)` calls with `ui.show_status_message(StatusKind::Skipped, ..., 4)`
- Replace `StatusKind::Blocked.format(&theme, ...)` with `ui.show_status_message(StatusKind::Blocked, ..., 4)`

## Verification

After each commit, all APE gates must pass:
- `cargo test --all-features` — 0 failures
- `cargo doc --no-deps --all-features` — 0 errors
- `cargo fmt -- --check` — 0 diffs
- `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` — 0 errors
- `cargo llvm-cov --all-features` — >= 90% coverage
- `cargo check --all-targets --all-features` — 0 errors
- `cargo build --release` — 0 errors

After both commits, verify:
- `runner/workflow.rs` has no imports from `ui::theme`, `ui::spinner`, or `indicatif`
- `ui/mod.rs` has no `use indicatif` import
- `live_output_callback` is no longer `pub`
